wages.measure: Reported average net monthly employee wages; national methods differ

prices.kosovo_method: KAS sampled average retail prices, table 3, page 10
prices.germany_method: ALDI Nord listed own-label prices; category comparisons, not identical SKUs

inflation.measure: Reported year-on-year consumer price change, percent; food includes non-alcoholic beverages

comparison_limits: These four staple categories are an illustrative sample, not a representative cost-of-living basket.
Retail price dates, sampling methods and product specifications differ.
Wage shares divide 2026 prices by 2025 reported net monthly wages; national wage methods differ.
Neither wage figure is asserted to be a median or a harmonised full-time-equivalent measure.
Inflation figures are the published August 2026 year-on-year rates, not annual-average inflation or a comparison made by splicing index series.

formulas.price_premium_pct: (Kosovo price / German price - 1) * 100; same formula for the basket
formulas.price_difference_eur: Kosovo price - German price; same formula for the basket
formulas.wage_share_pct: Basket price / reported monthly net wage * 100
formulas.income_equivalent_german_basket_price_eu: Kosovo basket price * German wage / Kosovo wage
formulas.equal_wage_share_kosovo_price_reduction_: (1 - Kosovo wage / German wage) * 100; reduction from a corresponding German price for equal wage shares
